extracted.name: Stained Glass Windows
extracted.description: An incredibly easy and delicious recipe for stained glass candy made with chocolate chips, chopped walnuts, flaked coconut, and colored marshmallows!
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.5 ounce) package rainbow colored miniature marshmallows
instruction_lines: Melt butter and chocolate chips in a pan over low heat. Let mixture cool slightly before stirring in walnuts and marshmallows. Set aside to cool completely.
Divide cooled dough into two even portions. Form each portion into a long roll. Coat rolls with coconut.
Wrap rolls in waxed paper and then again in plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight or longer.
